details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:797 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `POOL_CONFIG.read_text(...)` runs at import time inside the `@pytest.mark.parametrize` on `test_resolve_step_writes_the_slot_outputs`, and `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` does not exist, so collection of the whole module fails with `FileNotFoundError`.
  WHY: CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails with "1 error during collection" / exit 2, so none of the feature's tests run; both reviewers rated it BLOCKER, and the root cause is the missing config file (see the task gap).
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:22,753 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `import socket` (line 22) is never used (ruff F401), and `next(l for l in ...)` (line 753) uses an ambiguous variable name (ruff E741).
  WHY: The pre-push gate's ruff tier fails on these, which blocks the push. Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini rated F401 BLOCKER, sonnet/luna/glm rated MAJOR, and minimax rated E741 NIT (minimax put F401 inside its BLOCKER collection finding); the highest is used.
- tests/test_review_sandbox_hidden_build_dirs.py:121-127 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new chatgpt branch in scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh (~724-725) adds a third `install -m 0600 "${prompt}" "${root}/prompt"` followed by a tab-indented `review_append_hidden_build_note`, but the test still asserts `installs == 2` and a tab-indented follow count of 1.
  WHY: `test_sandbox_appends_the_note_after_every_prompt_install` now sees 3 installs and 2 follows and fails every time; all five rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:285-315 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `classify_chatgpt_events` the `CHATGPT_AUTH_RE`/`CHATGPT_QUOTA_RE` checks run before the success check, so a run that exits 0 with an agent message and no `turn.failed` is classed as `auth_rejected`/`quota_exhausted` if an earlier transient `error` event matches.
  WHY: review_untrusted_sandbox.sh then calls `chatgpt_unavailable` and exits 76, and `run_chatgpt_reviewer` maps that to `skipped_pool`, so a completed review is thrown away; all rated MAJOR.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1707-1741,1902-1919 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `reviewer_chatgpt_slot_resolve` removes `openai/gpt-6-luna` from `REVIEWER_MODELS`, so a configured `REVIEW_TIER_LITE_REVIEWER_SLUG`/`REVIEW_TIER_STANDARD_REVIEWER_SLUGS` naming that slug fails the `live_models_map` check in `resolve_review_tier_active_models` and falls back to `fallback_full_invalid_subset`.
  WHY: Lite and standard tiers run the full 5-reviewer panel instead of the configured subset, which contradicts "configured overrides still win". Severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT, the others MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2410-2471 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "Resolve AI engine" sets `chatgpt_slot=true` without checking that `replaces` is on `REVIEWER_MODELS`, so the "ChatGPT pool token" step (`id: chatgpt_pool`) fetches an account and writes auth.json even when the swap is later skipped (`replaces_not_in_panel`).
  WHY: Every such review makes a pointless broker read and credential write, which also skews the account-usage signal; all rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2436 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `echo "REVIEWER_CHATGPT: resolve slot=${chatgpt_slot} ${chatgpt_line:-reason=helper_unavailable}"` runs on every review, even when the slot is off.
  WHY: This breaks the Phase 2 rule that off-path panel, tiers and logs stay byte-for-byte unchanged; all rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Gate the whole ChatGPT path on `reviewer_slot_enabled` in `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json`" — Phase 2 step 1: `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` [new]: `{"reviewer_slot_enabled": false, "model": "gpt-6-sol", "replaces": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "reasoning": "xhigh"}`
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file; in files_touched grant)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The file is not among the 17 PR changed files (`pr_changed_files.txt`) and is not in the checkout, yet the changelog fragment, `agents.d/chatgpt-reviewer-slot.md`, `README.md:2690` ("shipped `false`"), the removal-registry entry and `test_shipped_config_keeps_the_slot_off` all describe it as shipped. `tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py` (POOL_CONFIG line 43, read at line 797) fails collection with `FileNotFoundError`. `resolve_chatgpt_slot` always returns `config_missing`, so the `REVIEWER_CHATGPT_SLOT_ENABLED=true` override can never turn the slot on.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_review_sandbox_hidden_build_dirs.py:124-126 (with scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh new chatgpt branch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A third prompt install, followed by the hidden-build note, was added, but the pinned test still asserts `installs == 2` and a tab-indented follow count of 1.
  WHY: `test_sandbox_appends_the_note_after_every_prompt_install` fails on both assertions; the expected counts should be 3 and 2, and the bare count stays 1.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:`classify_chatgpt_events` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The auth/quota regexes are checked over all `error` messages before the success condition, so transient errors (for example a retried 429, "login", "authenticat") reclassify a successful run.
  WHY: Exit 76 becomes `skipped_pool` and a valid review is thrown away; evaluate success first.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1902-1919 (`reviewer_chatgpt_slot_resolve` / `resolve_review_tier_active_models`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Configured tier slugs that name the replaced `openai/gpt-6-luna` become unknown when the slot is active.
  WHY: The tier fails open to the full roster; map the `replaces` slug to `REVIEWER_CHATGPT_SLOT_SLUG` during validation.
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:~797 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `POOL_CONFIG.read_text` in the module-level parametrize runs at import, and `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` is missing.
  WHY: The `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` collection fails with `FileNotFoundError` (exit 2), so no feature tests run.
- tests/test_review_chatgpt_reviewer_slot.py:22 (+ `next(l for l ...)` in `test_relay_is_staged_as_optional_support`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Ruff F401 (unused `import socket`) and E741 (ambiguous name `l`).
  WHY: The pre-push gate's ruff tier fails.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:"Resolve AI engine" / "ChatGPT pool token" (`id: chatgpt_pool`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The token is fetched and auth.json written even when `chatgpt_replaces` is not on `REVIEWER_MODELS`.
  WHY: A pointless `/v1/chatgpt` read and credential write, which skews usage; reuse the panel-matching pipeline.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:"Resolve AI engine" `echo "REVIEWER_CHATGPT: resolve slot=..."` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The log line is emitted unconditionally, against docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md:255-256 (off-path logs byte-for-byte unchanged).
  WHY: Off-path logs differ; emit only when the slot is true or the reason is not `switch_off`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Gate the whole ChatGPT path on `reviewer_slot_enabled` in `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` ... shipped value and must stay false"; Phase 2 step 1 new file `{"reviewer_slot_enabled": false, "model": "gpt-6-sol", "replaces": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "reasoning": "xhigh"}`.
  Expected change site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file; in files_touched grant).
  Evidence of absence: The file is not among the 17 changed files and is absent on the ref. Docs and tests describe it as shipped, `resolve_chatgpt_slot` always returns `config_missing`, the override can't enable the slot, and the test module fails collection.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
